PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_2 Autonomy Planning Baseline
PHASE.GOAL: Create sharded MyGRACE plan, graph, and verification surfaces for UPGRADE_2 autonomous agent upgrades before source implementation.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: UPGRADE_2 source tasks are mapped to planned modules, phase gates, and verification shards without generating source code.
Existing M-RUNNER, M-GRACE, M-GRAPHRAG, M-MCP, and M-CLI ownership boundaries remain the integration anchors.

STEPS.step-1: Define self-heal loop ownership, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
STEPS.step-2: Define failure XML diagnosis ownership and integration with Debugger.
STEPS.step-3: Define resumable run context and CLI agent command surfaces.
STEPS.step-4: Define phase-gate checking and safe plan-index progression.
STEPS.step-5: Define automatic contract repair boundaries and dry-run requirements.
STEPS.step-6: Define graph impact analysis result and MCP operation surfaces.
STEPS.step-7: Define pre-commit verification gate and self-heal handoff behavior.
STEPS.step-8: Define multi-agent handoff artifact model and storage layout.

VERIFICATION.CHECK: User approved UPGRADE_2 planning baseline for artifact generation.

RISKS.RISK: Planning shards must not imply code exists before implementation phases create source files.
